name: Animate Water (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
School transmutation [water]; Level druid 1, shaman 1

Casting Time 1 round

Components V, S, M (a drop of water)

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target one small patch of water

Duration 1 round/level (D)

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

You animate a small patch of water the size of a small creature. For the duration, the animated water has the statistics of a small water elemental. At the end of the duration, the animated water splashes down in the square it was occupying. The animated water cannot move beyond the range of the spell from the caster.
